service.description: Mint a per-client API key for the public GraphQL tier, for the caller's ACTIVE tenant: every read made with the key is fixed to that tenant, even when the caller also administers others. Tenant admin of the active tenant, or super-admin. SECURITY: generates a cryptographically-random key (SecureRandom, 256 bits, URL-safe base64, prefixed "dgql_"), stores ONLY its SHA-256 hex digest, and returns the RAW key exactly ONCE in the `apiKey` out-param. The raw key is NOT recoverable afterwards — capture it now or re-mint.

parameter.name: apiKey
parameter.description: The RAW key, shown ONCE and not recoverable. Deliver securely to the client.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: The tenant the key is fixed to: the caller's active tenant.

return.message: Minting a public GraphQL API key requires tenant-admin access to the active tenant.
Only a super-admin can give an API key a cost profile.

entity-make-value.map: [apiKeyId:apiKeyId, keyHash:org.moqui.gql.auth.ApiKeyHasher.sha256Hex(apiKey), companyUserGroupId:companyUserGroupId, profileId:profileId, clientName:clientName, enabled:'Y', expireDate:expireDate, createdDate:ec.user.nowTimestamp]

log.message: gql: minted API key apiKeyId=${apiKeyId} client='${clientName}' tenant=${companyUserGroupId}

service.description: Internal: validate a presented raw API key fail-closed and return its fixed tenant + profile. SECURITY: hashes the key (SHA-256) and looks it up BY HASH (no raw compare, no substring/like match) — this also avoids timing leaks on the raw key. A blank/missing key, no matching row, enabled != 'Y', or a passed expireDate all resolve as invalid. On any failure `valid` is false and the error message is the generic "invalid API key" (the specific failing check is never leaked). On success returns companyUserGroupId/profileId/apiKeyId/ clientName and best-effort updates lastUsedDate.
The active tenant's public GraphQL API keys, newest first: id, label (clientName), tenant, profile, whether enabled, created, expires and last used (to the minute). Never the key or its digest.

parameter.name: apiKeys
parameter.description: One Map per key; see the service description.

return.message: Listing public GraphQL API keys requires tenant-admin access to the active tenant.

iterate.script: apiKeys.add([apiKeyId: key.apiKeyId, clientName: key.clientName, companyUserGroupId: key.companyUserGroupId, profileId: key.profileId, enabled: key.enabled == 'Y', createdDate: key.createdDate, expireDate: key.expireDate, lastUsedDate: key.lastUsedDate, active: key.enabled == 'Y' && (key.expireDate == null || key.expireDate.after(nowStamp))])

service.description: Turn a key off now: every request with it fails as an invalid API key from the next request on. Idempotent. Active tenant's keys only.

return.message: Disabling a public GraphQL API key requires tenant-admin access to the active tenant.

log.message: gql: disabled API key apiKeyId=${apiKeyId} client='${key.clientName}' tenant=${key.companyUserGroupId}

service.description: Replace a key without an outage: mints a new key for the same tenant, profile and label, returns the RAW new key exactly once, and gives the old key a short expiry so the agent can switch over. Only an enabled, unexpired key can be rotated; a leaked key should be disabled instead. Active tenant's keys only.

parameter.name: graceMinutes
parameter.description: How long the old key keeps working, 0 to 1440 minutes; 0 ends it now.

parameter.name: expireDate
parameter.description: The new key's expiry; blank keeps the old key's expiry, if it has one.

parameter.name: apiKey
parameter.description: The RAW new key, shown ONCE and not recoverable.

parameter.name: oldKeyExpireDate
parameter.description: When the old key stops working.

return.message: Rotating a public GraphQL API key requires tenant-admin access to the active tenant.
API key ${apiKeyId} is disabled or expired; mint a new key instead

entity-make-value.map: [apiKeyId:newApiKeyId, keyHash:org.moqui.gql.auth.ApiKeyHasher.sha256Hex(apiKey), companyUserGroupId:oldKey.companyUserGroupId, profileId:oldKey.profileId, clientName:oldKey.clientName, enabled:'Y', expireDate:(expireDate ?: oldKey.expireDate), createdDate:nowStamp]

log.message: gql: rotated API key apiKeyId=${apiKeyId} -> ${newApiKeyId} client='${oldKey.clientName}' tenant=${oldKey.companyUserGroupId}; old key ends ${oldKeyExpireDate}
